title: SAC telegram on Echo Flight demands Boeing investigation
place_text: Strategic Air Command headquarters / Malmstrom AFB

tellings.quote: There were uh one of the documents we received from the air force was a telegram or TX about the echoflight shutdown.

plain: A former US Air Force officer, Robert Salas, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a 1967 telegram the Air Force released to him from Strategic Air Command, the branch that ran America's nuclear bombers and missiles. Salas says the telegram concerns the shutdown of Echo Flight, a group of nuclear missiles at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, and calls for Boeing, the company that built the missiles, to investigate. Salas tells this as support for his account that a UFO shut down nuclear missiles, which would mean something unknown could switch off America's nuclear weapons.
